prompts.prompt: Generate ONE square 1024x1024 grayscale scalar HEIGHT MAP texture for real-time game material implementation, based on the specified column of the attached approved concept board. The board is an art reference ONLY. Output the single full-bleed orthographic TOP DOWN height map, no board, no labels, no frames, no text, no perspective, no baked lighting, no highlights or cast shadows. All pixels neutral grayscale. Pixel brightness means geometric surface height: white=highest ridge, black=lowest trough. Broad smooth transitions and coherent sculpted fine relief, continuous soft derivatives, no pure-white thin outlines. Seamless tileable repeat on opposite edges. Rich irregular macrostructure, multiple feature sizes, no identical repeated cells, no regular grid. This will generate color and normals from one physically coherent field. Do NOT output a shaded/rendered surface or RGB normal map. Use the WASSER column: shallow liquid water surface with irregular broad branching and merging flow ridges, several rounded asymmetric dark basins separated by broad raised ribbons, delicate ripples following the large flow ribbons. Smooth, softly sloping water shapes, subdued micro ripples. About 12 to 20 irregular dark basins over the entire tile, size strongly variable, not bubble circles; retain broad areas with lower detail. No solid crust or granulated rock.
